state.paragraph: Between April 3, 2016 and April 6, 2016, representatives of GHF and members of the Company's management held a series of introductory meetings with five potential strategic buyers (including G&W) at the American Short Line and Regional Railroad Association's 2016 Connections Convention ("2016 Connections Convention").

ledger_rows.Note: Class I rail partner; at a commercial meeting suggested joint ventures and interest in acquiring equity in the Company (no price; not a whole-company offer). Prompted Board to have a subcommittee interview bankers.

ledger_rows.Who: Greene Holcomb & Fisher LLC (GHF), later BMO Capital Markets
ledger_rows.Note: Target's financial adviser (only one named), engaged by Board on subcommittee recommendation. BMO acquired GHF's business 08/01/2016 and continued the mandate; BMO gave the 08/12/2016 fairness opinion.

Board adopted GHF's proposed 'exploratory transaction strategy': continue talks with Party A and solicit other change-in-control interest. Formed Transaction Committee (Barrett, Anderson, Garvey), which could not approve a deal.
Target's legal counsel; first seen acting 03/24/2016, attending Transaction Committee meetings.
GHF outreach wave began, executing the Committee's 03/24 authorization to contact Party A and other buyers (management had told Party A of GHF's engagement on 03/22-23).
GHF contacted 11 potential strategic buyers; Party A (#1) is the eleventh. All 11 later signed NDAs.
GHF contacted 18 potential financial buyers; 14 later signed NDAs, 4 did not.

All 11 contacted strategic buyers; no standstills. Includes Party A and G&W (NDA dated 04/03/2016). Parties E and F, and probably B, are members but the filing does not say so. Memorandum later sent to signers.
14 of the 18 contacted financial buyers; no standstills. Party D is presumably a member (only financial signers before July). Filing's total: 25 NDAs.
Company management approached them about a possible transaction; filing reports no response and no NDA.
Every potential buyer told to submit a non-binding IOI by 05/10/2016; memorandum already sent to NDA signers.
IOI due date moved from 05/10 to 05/19/2016. Day not given; Date from assumes 05/10 was still operative at the 04/27 Board discussion.
IOI due date reached. IOIs arrived 05/19 to 06/01.

Range for the group; $/share assumes preferred converts; equity $90M-$134M. Made before data-site access. By later events includes B, G&W, D, E, F and the two LOI non-submitters (#29-30): 5 strategic, 2 financial, 2 unknown.
25 NDA signers (#8-9) − 9 IOI bidders (#14) = 16. None reappears. May include Party A, which the filing never mentions after March.
Transaction Committee excluded the two lowest IOIs from management presentations to save management time. Identities and types not disclosed; may include Party A.
Committee advanced the other seven IOI bidders to in-person management presentations and further diligence; all seven got internet data-site access.
Non-binding LOIs due 07/20/2016 with mark-ups of the merger agreement, disclosure letter and voting agreement; price per share for 100% of common. Drafts posted 06/29, 06/30, 07/11.
LOI due date reached; six LOIs arrived in late July, G&W's on 07/21.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
